description: This file defines types and functions related to chat model references, including building, resolving, and formatting chat model identifiers, as well as handling catalog entries.

methods.name: buildQualifiedChatModelValue
methods.description: Constructs a qualified chat model string, optionally including provider.

methods.name: createChatModelOverride
methods.description: Creates a chat model override object from a string value.

methods.name: normalizeChatModelOverrideValue
methods.description: Resolves a chat model override to its string value using a catalog.

methods.name: resolveChatModelOverride
methods.description: Resolves a chat model override to its detailed resolution including source and reason.

methods.name: resolveServerChatModelValue
methods.description: Builds a qualified chat model string from model and provider.

methods.name: resolvePreferredServerChatModel
methods.description: Determines the preferred chat model resolution considering override and catalog.

methods.name: resolvePreferredServerChatModelValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of the preferred server chat model.

methods.name: formatChatModelDisplay
methods.description: Formats a chat model string for display, reordering provider and model.

methods.name: buildChatModelOption
methods.description: Creates an option object for a catalog entry with value and label.
